n = int(input().strip())
K = int(input().strip())

MOD = 1000000007

def sum_mod(a, b):
    a += b
    if a >= MOD:
        a -= MOD
    return a

def mult_mod(a, b):
    res = a * b
    if res >= MOD:
        res %= MOD
    return res

class Mat:
    def __init__(self, N, M):
        self.N = N
        self.M = M
        self.data = [[0 for _ in range(M)] for _ in range(N)]
    
    def reset(self):
        for i in range(self.N):
            for j in range(self.M):
                self.data[i][j] = 0
    
    def set_identity(self):
        self.reset()
        for i in range(min(self.N, self.M)):
            self.data[i][i] = 1
    
    def transpose(self):
        t = Mat(self.M, self.N)
        t.reset()
        for i in range(self.M):
            for j in range(self.N):
                t.data[i][j] = self.data[j][i]
        return t
    
    def get_row(self, r):
        return self.data[r]
    
    def add(self, other):
        res = Mat(self.N, self.M)
        for i in range(self.N):
            for j in range(self.M):
                res.data[i][j] = sum_mod(self.data[i][j], other.data[i][j])
        return res
    
    def multiply_by(self, scalar):
        res = Mat(self.N, self.M)
        for i in range(self.N):
            for j in range(self.M):
                res.data[i][j] = mult_mod(self.data[i][j], scalar)
        return res
    
    @staticmethod
    def multiply(a, b):
        N, M = a.N, b.M
        out = Mat(N, M)
        out.reset()
        for i in range(a.N):
            for j in range(a.M):
                if a.data[i][j]:
                    for k in range(b.M):
                        out.data[i][k] = sum_mod(out.data[i][k], mult_mod(a.data[i][j], b.data[j][k]))
        return out

# Initialize matrices
A = [[Mat(35, 35) for _ in range(K)] for _ in range(65)]
S = [[Mat(35, 35) for _ in range(K)] for _ in range(65)]
P = [[Mat(35, 35) for _ in range(K)] for _ in range(65)]
ans = Mat(35, 35)

for i in range(K):
    A[0][i].set_identity()
    for j in range(K + 1):
        A[0][i].data[i][j] = 1

length = K
i_idx = 1
while length <= n:
    # Compute S[i-1][j]
    S[i_idx - 1][K - 1] = A[i_idx - 1][K - 1]
    for j in range(K - 2, -1, -1):
        S[i_idx - 1][j] = Mat.multiply(A[i_idx - 1][j], S[i_idx - 1][j + 1])
    # Compute P[i-1][j]
    P[i_idx - 1][0] = A[i_idx - 1][0]
    for j in range(1, K):
        P[i_idx - 1][j] = Mat.multiply(P[i_idx - 1][j - 1], A[i_idx - 1][j])
    # Compute A[i]
    A[i_idx][0] = S[i_idx - 1][0]
    for j in range(1, K):
        A[i_idx][j] = Mat.multiply(S[i_idx - 1][j], P[i_idx - 1][j - 1])
    length *= K
    i_idx += 1

# Convert n to base K digits
digits = []
temp_n = n
while temp_n:
    digits.append(temp_n % K)
    temp_n //= K

s = 0
ans.set_identity()

# Process digits from most significant to least
for digit in reversed(digits):
    for j in range(digit):
        ans = Mat.multiply(ans, A[len(digits) - 1][(j + s) % K])
    s = (s + digit) % K

res = 1
for i in range(K):
    res = sum_mod(res, ans.data[i][K])

print(res)
